PROGRESS NOTE (SOAP) -- Pediatrics Pt: Bram Frost 7 y/o M Date: 1/16/2083 Seen by: Rhonda Achterberg, NP Accompanied by: Mrs. Frost
S: Sore throat and fever x 2 days, no cough. Hes been home from school. Mom reports the cold weather, "it was a hard frost this morning" and he did not want breakfast. Sibling at home with a cold. No rash. Eats little. Pain 3/10.
O: T 38.6, HR up appropriately for fever. Throat red, tonsils swollen with exudate, tender anterior cervical nodes. No rash. Lungs clear. Rapid strep POSITIVE.
A: Strep throat. Ear exam normal, which is good given the history of otitis in 2076.
P: Penicillin V 250 mg twice daily for 10 days. Rest, fluids. Return to school after 24 h of antibiotics. Mom to call if no better in 48 hrs. Note was dictated using speech to text "strep thought" LOL means strep throat.
Cc: Dr. Oluwaseun Adebayo-Clarke
Plan discussed with Delphine who will pick up the Rx at the pharmacy. Her cell is 608-555-0142. - R. Achterberg NP
